title: Machine Learning Engineer
description:
Job Title: ML Engineer
Location: Noida
Experience Required: 36 years
About the Job
We are looking for a Machine Learning Engineer to design, build, and deploy ML models that power intelligent agent systems and enterprise AI solutions.
The Machine Learning Engineer will be responsible for developing scalable ML pipelines, optimizing models for performance, and ensuring robust deployment in production environments. This role requires strong technical expertise in ML algorithms and practical experience in MLOps.
Responsibilities
Hands-on experience in deploying ML models at scale with automated monitoring and retraining in production environments.
Design and implement machine learning models for prediction, classification, and optimization tasks.
Build and maintain scalable ML pipelines for data ingestion, training, and deployment.
Collaborate with data scientists and engineers to integrate models into agent workflows.
Monitor and improve model performance post-deployment using automated retraining strategies.
Ensure compliance with best practices for security, reliability, and ethical AI.
Mandatory Skills
Proficiency in Python, TensorFlow, and PyTorch.
Experience with ML pipelines and MLOps tools (MLflow, Kubeflow).
Strong understanding of data preprocessing, feature engineering, and model evaluation metrics.
Familiarity with cloud platforms (AWS, Azure, GCP) for ML deployment.
Additional Skills
Knowledge of LLM integration and hybrid AI systems.
Experience with containerization (Docker) and orchestration (Kubernetes).
Exposure to CI/CD pipelines for ML workflows.

title: Senior Machine Learning Engineer
description:
WHAT MAKES US A GREAT PLACE TO WORK
We are proud to be consistently recognized as one of the world's best places to work. We are currently the #1 ranked consulting firm on Glassdoor's Best Places to Work list and have maintained a spot in the top four on Glassdoor's list since its founding in 2009. Extraordinary teams are at the heart of our business strategy, but these don't happen by chance. They require intentional focus on bringing together a broad set of backgrounds, cultures, experiences, perspectives, and skills in a supportive and inclusive work environment. We hire people with exceptional talent and create an environment in which every individual can thrive professionally and personally.
WHO YOU'LL WORK WITH
You'll join our Machine Learning and Data Scienceexperts within the AI, Insights & Solutionsteam. This team is part of Bain's digital capabilities practice, which includes experts in analytics, engineering, product management, and design. In this multidisciplinary environment, you'll leverage deep technical expertise with business acumen to help clients tackle their most transformative challenges. You'll work on integrated teams alongside our general consultants and clients to develop data-driven strategies and innovative solutions. Together, we create human-centric solutions that harness the power of data and artificial intelligence to drive competitive advantage for our clients. Our collaborative and supportive work environment fosters creativity and continuous learning, enabling us to consistently deliver exceptional results.
WHERE YOU'LL FIT WITHIN THE TEAM
As a Machine Learning Engineer, you'll help drive innovation by integrating AI and data-driven solutions into strategy and execution. Whether launching new ventures, reimagining user experiences, or building tech-enabled products, you'll work at the intersection of analytics and impactturning bold strategies into breakthrough results.Bain offers comprehensive benefits and flexible policies that are designed to support you, so you can thrive personally and professionally.
WHAT YOU'LL DO
Design, build, and deliver statistical/ML models and agentic AI/LLM solutions to solve high-impact client problems.
Architect and implement production-grade ML systems by building enterprise-grade services, applying MLOps and CI/CD for reliable deployment and monitoring, and ensuring high standards in engineering quality and documentation.
Partner with general consulting teams and client stakeholders to translate business problems into ML solutions, prioritize work, and enable enterprisescale AI transformation.
Continuously research emerging frameworks and stateoftheart AI (e.g., LLMs, agents, retrieval, post-training, etc.) and convert learnings into reusable frameworks, components, and accelerators used across industries and functions.
Share knowledge and mentor others on best practices tools, and approaches in applied machine learning and AI engineering.
Contribute to internal R&D and learning initiatives to advance Bain's AI capabilities and foster continuous innovation between projects.
ABOUT YOU
Must Have:
3+ years of relevant experience or an advanced degree
Strong theoretical and practical experience in machine learning
Proficiency in Python, with solid software engineering foundations including clean code practices, testing, version control, and CI/CD workflows.
Experience with cloud platforms(e.g., AWS, GCP, Azure) and deploying ML/AI applications.
Comprehensive understanding of the ML lifecycle, from experimentation and model development to deployment.
Experience productionizing and exposing ML models (e.g., using FastAPI, Flask, or similar frameworks) for seamless integration into applications and platforms.
Excellent communicator and collaborator, able to align with technical and business stakeholders in a fast-paced, cross-functional environment.
Curious and growth-oriented, passionate about exploring new tools, mentoring peers, and sharing best practices.
Adaptable and self-driven, comfortable operating with autonomy, embracing feedback, and learning new skills to deliver client impact.
Location: New Delhi, Bengaluru, Mumbai (Hybrid)
Travel is required. This position requires regional travel away from your home office/primary working location. Travel frequency and destinations will vary based on project needs.
Nice to Have:
Experience with R&D or academic research
Interest in publishing technical content and mentoring others
